title: Creator Pro v1 và brand deals
scope_items: Database Migration 00033: Created link_in_bio_pages, link_items, media_kits, rate_cards, rate_card_items, brand_deals tables with composite tenant keys (uq_*_tenant_pk), tenant foreign keys, strict tenant RLS isolation (ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY), check constraints, and role-based app_user/admin_user grants.

Acceptance Target 1 (Canonical deal lifecycle): Implemented canonical 6-state progression (negotiating -> agreed -> in_progress -> delivered -> paid -> completed) plus cancellation. Skipping states is rejected. Cancellation requires a non-empty reason. Cancelling after paid status strictly requires audited financial reversal confirmation. Completed deals are strictly terminal. Sponsor inquiries convert smoothly into canonical negotiating brand deals.

Acceptance Target 2 (Phishing cannot be acknowledged away): Link security engine scans all URL destinations against threat intelligence. Any confirmed phishing or malware URL is hard-blocked from being published or set active; no creator AUP acknowledgment can override or publish a phishing URL. Enforced daily creation throttle of max 20 links/day/workspace with audit event logging.

Acceptance Target 3 (Zero-view RPM undefined): Revenue Per Content RPM calculation strictly returns undefined/null when views == 0 rather than false 0.0 or NaN. Evaluates RPM trend comparisons with >20% decline trigger alerts. Rolls up derivative performance to source content accurately.

Acceptance Target 4 (All six modes can reach entitled tools): Configured access matrix for all 6 operator modes (creator, seller, agency, affiliate, brand_collab, live_operator). All entitled tools (bio_pages, media_kits, rate_cards, brand_deals, content_roi, tax_reports) remain directly reachable from any workspace mode according to S16 §8.2.

Custom Domain Verification & Tax Reports: CNAME DNS verification with deterministic retry and status states. Multi-period (monthly/quarterly/yearly) and multi-format (PDF/XLSX/CSV) tax export reporting summarizing revenue by platform and source with AI/subscription expense deductions.
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget1_CanonicalDealLifecycle, TestAcceptanceTarget1_CancellationAndFinancialReversal, and TestSponsorInquiryConversionToBrandDeal in Go (-race), Vitest creator_pro.test.ts, and Flutter creator_pro_acceptance_test.dart confirm sequential transitions, cancel reasons, financial reversal gates, and terminal status.

Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget2_PhishingCannotBeAcknowledgedAway and TestAcceptanceTarget2_DailyLinkThrottle in Go (-race), Vitest creator_pro.test.ts, and Flutter creator_pro_acceptance_test.dart confirm non-overridable phishing publishing blocks and daily 20-link workspace throttles.

Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget3_ZeroViewRPMUndefined and TestAcceptanceTarget3_RPMTrendAndDropAlert in Go (-race), Vitest creator_pro.test.ts, and Flutter creator_pro_acceptance_test.dart confirm RPM undefined when views=0, derivative roll-up, and >20% decline notification alerts.

Acceptance Target 4 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget4_AllSixModesCanReachEntitledTools in Go (-race), Vitest creator_pro.test.ts, and Flutter creator_pro_acceptance_test.dart confirm that all six operator modes can access entitled tools without artificial dead ends.

Migration 00033 Verified: TestLoadAndValidateCanonicalP004Migration and TestUpStatusDownTransactionalBehavior in migrator_test.go verify clean up, status check, and down rollback for all 33 migrations.
Proto Codegen & Static Invariants: Buf lint and verify mode pass with 0 drift across Go, TS, and Dart. TypeScript shared types compile cleanly without emit errors.

Web & Mobile Quality Gates: Svelte-check found 0 errors and 0 warnings, Vite production build succeeded, SSR smoke passed all routes including /creator-pro (HTTP 200), Flutter analyze found 0 issues, and all Flutter tests passed.
external_gates: Google Safe Browsing API native production probe requires active cloud project and API key; local fallback and threat intelligence heuristics verify detection logic without network dependencies.
Custom domain automated DNS and SSL provisioning requires production edge ingress/Cloudflare automation; local DNS CNAME validation executes deterministic resolution checks.
Legal review and electronic-signature external gateway remain external launch gates per DEC-001; contract templates attach versioned immutable evidence without legal liability.
remaining_scope: P8-07: Retained expansion brand collaboration workspace — Kanban interactive drag-and-drop board view, contract template authoring studio, opt-in creator marketplace directory search, and automated external invoice generation (PRD §16, §37.1).
decisions: Canonical Deal Lifecycle: brand_deals.status follows negotiating -> agreed -> in_progress -> delivered -> paid -> completed; cancelled requires mandatory reason and financial reversal audit if paid; completed is terminal.
Security Hard Blocks: Confirmed phishing URLs can never be published or activated regardless of AUP acknowledgment (SAFE-2026-02); mass link creation throttled at max 20 links/day/workspace.
Zero-View RPM: RPM calculation strictly returns undefined/null when views == 0 to prevent division by zero or false 0.0 metrics; RPM drop alert triggers at >20% period-over-period decline.
Mode Entitlement: All six workspace modes (creator, seller, agency, affiliate, brand_collab, live_operator) retain reachable access to their entitled Creator Pro tools per S16 §8.2.
